title: R.A. NDE 6492
content: This experience was many years ago, but its impact on me was profound enough that I recall general impressions of it as well as some of its specific events. I believe that the experience only lasted for a few minutes. I lost touch with earthly reality very quickly, but my consciousness continued. First, I experienced a quick, but comprehensive, replay of my life. It was similar to watching a movie of my life, except that I was 'in' the movie, rapidly re-experiencing my life's events. I experienced something like the 'traveling through a tunnel' feature, but for me it seemed more as if the tunnel came to me. I saw a circle of light that quickly grew in size until I was inside of it. Once I was inside the light, I was aware that it was much more intense than earthly light. The light seemed to be coming from a sun that was so big that it covered most of the sky. I remember with certainty, being joined by a friend who had died about six months previously. We had an interaction that felt really similar to those we used to have on Earth. I think there are some other details of my experience that have slipped my mind after all these years. Something else I remember clearly, though, was feeling full of acceptance, forgiveness, and love, and that there was a complete lack of negative feelings, such as hatred and revenge. Then I became aware that I was again back in my body, quivering and shaking, as I regained earthly consciousness. I would liken my experience to this. It was if I had lived my whole life in a bubble at the bottom of a dark ocean, and one day the bubble broke loose from the ocean floor. I rose to the surface of the sea and my eyes were flooded by the light of day. I initially believed that during this experience, I had been in the presence of God. Over the years I had some real struggles, wondering about which being, God or Satan, had been its source. I cannot prove which one it was, but I do tend to believe that in this case, it was God. To this day, I am very careful about not being misled by false prophets. I know the difficulty that people have with correct discernment when influenced by spiritual beings and, over the years, since my experience, there have been times when I have felt that I was undergoing spiritual disruptions and attacks, and have sought protection from God.

tunnel.passage_other_detail: It seemed more as if the tunnel came to me; I saw a circle of light that quickly grew in size until I was inside of it.

arrival.religious_figure_detail: Initially believed I had been in the presence of God; later struggled whether it was God or Satan; tends to believe it was God.
arrival.other_being_detail: Joined by a friend who had died about six months previously.

environment.environment_other_detail: Light much more intense than earthly light; like coming from a sun so big it covered most of the sky.

stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: Life review occurred first, followed by a tunnel-like light circle expanding around the experiencer; then encounter with deceased friend; then return to body.

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: Tunnel described as coming to the experiencer: a circle of light that grew until they were inside it; later prolonged concern about discernment (God vs Satan) and perceived spiritual disruptions/attacks after the experience.
unique_elements.notable_quotes: “It was similar to watching a movie of my life, except that I was 'in' the movie, rapidly re-experiencing my life's events.”
